journey.name: Request Payment Without Contacts
journey.description: The Request Payment button on the Subscriptions Payments tab shows even without contacts. With no saved contacts it opens Add Contact instead of the request flow; with saved contacts it opens the recipient picker, which says when none of them can receive a request. Requires a fresh wallet with Paykit UI enabled, a Pubky profile and no contacts.

actions.action: Launch the E2E Bitkit app with Paykit UI enabled, a signed-in Pubky profile and no contacts
Open the drawer menu and tap Subscriptions, then tap the Payments tab
Verify the empty state shows NO PAYMENT HISTORY and Request Payment (testTag "PaymentRequestCreate") at the bottom
Verify the Contacts screen opens with the Add Contact sheet shown
